text:
Aisha K.: Heads up — we're prepping an SI handoff SOP for the CloudPartner co-sell program. Need a clear lead flow + account map. Sharing a quick draft template below.

partners-bot: uploaded doc: https://drive.redwood/partners/si-handoff-draft :thumbsup:

Jamal R.: Nice start. Can we standardize owner tags: SI_owner / RW_owner / AE_owner? Also add a 'no_contact' flag for restricted accts.

Sophia M.: +1 on tags. Propose SLAs for acknowledgment: AE 24h to accept lead, SI 48h to qualify. If none -> auto-return to PS for reassignment.

Ethan P.: Overlap risk on territories. Suggest account-match priority: 1) GSI coverage, 2) existing AE relationship, 3) geography fallback. We can script a scoring function.

Aisha K.: Quick handoff template (copy into CRM):
```text
Lead source: SI
SI rep: {name}
Redwood AE: {name}
Ownership window: 7 days
Next action: Intro call scheduled by SI within 3 business days
NDA_required: true/false
Compliance_flags: {HIPAA, SOC2, etc}
Notes: {brief}
```

Jamal R.: We should also have a 'Co-sell Rules of Engagement' one-pager for legal & GTM — I'll draft. Keep it lightweight.

Sophia M.: Also need a marketing/joint-announcement checklist: joint logo approval, press embargo window, marketplace listing lead times.

Aisha K.: Action items:
- Jamal: draft RoE one-pager (due Fri)
- Ethan: propose account-matching logic + sample query (due Tue)
- Sophia: marketplace & announcement checklist (due Wed)
- partners-bot: create CRM tag 'si-co-sell' and webhook for handoffs

partners-bot: created ticket PRTN-4321 and webhook configured :white_check_mark:

Ethan P.: tagging @Marta L. (legal) — can you skim the liabilities/NDA section when Jamal posts?

Marta L.: Happy to review. Quick Q: do we require NDA before intro or only before sharing sensitive docs? We should codify in the template.

Aisha K.: Prefer soft intro first; NDA only for PII/regulatory accounts. Add NDA_required boolean and a recommended phrasing for intro emails.

Sophia M.: Recommend running a 6-week pilot with 2 SIs after docs are live. Measure time-to-first-meeting, conversion rate, and any handoff friction.

Jamal R.: I'll push the initial RoE & sample intro email tonight and link here.

Aisha K.: Thanks — I'll sync with GTM tomorrow 9am to align on pilot and measurement. Calendar invite incoming. :calendar:

partners-bot: Meeting created: Tomorrow 09:00 PST — invites sent to participants.

Aisha K.: If anyone has edge cases (gov/regulatory customers, channel conflicts), drop them in this thread before the sync.

Ethan P.: Noted — will add a sample SQL to flag restricted accounts in the onboarding script.

Jamal R.: filing PR with RoE draft now.

Aisha K.: Great work team — short, tight docs will move faster.
